# Anne Shirley & Phil Gordon

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — served as her bridesmaid · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002), +11 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feel dwarfed by their new environment. Later in the afternoon, they explore Old St. John's Cemetery, where they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a vibrant student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) who instantly befriends them.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats lightly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her undecided romantic life between [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), her family, and her reluctance to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects emotionally on history before she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss Philippa's surprisingly endearing character.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen class wins the annual Arts Rush under Gilbert's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly befriends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them to her broad social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of comforting letters from home, including updates from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk through the park and into town. As they linger, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss life, sorrrow, and happiness while taking in the sunset. On their way home, the group discovers a charming old house called Patty's Place on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) instantly feels connected to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P21](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0021), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032), [v3 ch.Park P40](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0040)_

> After completing their first-term examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) heads to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is joyfully welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and the twins, later helping little [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resolve his guilt over wanting to say a bad word. Over [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from Miss Lavendar, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, back at their lodgings, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) begs and receives permission to join their household at Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), decorating the house and taking in pets. After an unsuccessful attempt to chloroform a stray cat, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formally adopts [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who joins [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) in their new home.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)_

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) shares her easygoing approach to chaperoning the girls at Patty's Place. Meanwhile, her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), settle in, with the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly asserting dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) while [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) engage in ongoing battles before eventually becoming close friends.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) returns home to the girls' cozy cottage with snow-covered boots and news on butter prices. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads a humorous letter from young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), detailing his recent school composition and various happenings back home.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006)_

> On her twentieth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on growing up in conversation with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs dressed for a dance and chats playfully about her suitors and appearance before departing.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Interlude P35](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat inside Patty's Place before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps outside into the orchard. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) heartbroken and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upset over the loss of their friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P36](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant fortnight in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), where she visits her birthplace and explores her parents' old home. The current occupant gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a bundle of old love letters written by her parents. After visiting their graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads the letters at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly) and feels truly connected to her parents for the first time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P12](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0012), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

> While preparing for the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), feeling unusually off-kilter, and immediately notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

> While studying for examinations at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can stay for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) proposed to her and she accepted.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v3 ch.Confidences P14](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0014), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and unpack while catching up with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cheer themselves up during a rainy evening by reading old, overly tragic stories written during their [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P30](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0030), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her stories, delighting her and the household. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit Patty's Place on Saturday. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive unexpectedly on Friday while the household is unprepared, leading to an awkward visit featuring rambunctious cats and a flattened chocolate cake.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022)_

> As examinations finish and graduation arrives, the girls at Patty's Place reflect on what they have learned from their college experience. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's flowers over Roy's. Later, after hearing a rumor of Gilbert's engagement to Christine, she breaks her pink heart chain in secret distress and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

> As the housemates pack up Patty's Place and reflect on their [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) years, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) out to propose to her. Although everyone expects [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to accept, she realizes in the moment that she does not truly love him and refuses his proposal. A devastated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home and confesses what happened to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who scolds her at first before offering comfort.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn
